steps.text: Keep guardians in front and fragile cats behind.
Choose a gear slot to compare upgrades.
Save a crew for each activity.
Select gear to compare stats and equip a cat.
Enhance gear here. Review costs before confirming.
Open the workshop to fuse matching gear.
Preview the next level before spending materials.
Check odds. Failed attempts add Blessing.
Review the material cost, then confirm.
Spend bound Bells. YARN never buys random outcomes.
Open Odds before pulling. Pity increases your next chance.
Choose a banner. Featured guarantees carry between matching banners.
Duplicate cats give shards. Each invitation saves immediately.
Content seasons last four weeks. Check the countdown.
Play weekly goals for bound rewards.
Edition supply shows verified counts, or Offline.
Guardians hold front. Witches hit groups. Alchemists heal.
Front cats protect the back row.
These portraits show who acts next.
Read enemy intent. Choose targeting before battle.
Full rage readies ultimates. Auto casts on legal turns.
Status icons show shields, burns, and delays.
Pack supplies before battle. Your packed treat appears here.
Change speed here. Pause and Auto remain available.
